parameters.name: product
parameters.description:
The product code.

- Call the GetRequestLog operation to obtain the product code from the response.

- Find the product code in the product's OpenAPI Portal URL. <props="china">For example, the OpenAPI Portal URL for Short Message Service is https\://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi. The product code for Short Message Service is Dysmsapi.</props>
  <props="intl">For example, the OpenAPI Portal URL for Short Message Service is https\://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi. The product code for Short Message Service is Dysmsapi.</props>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun openapiexplorer get-api-definition --product Ecs --biz-api-version 2014-05-26 --api DescribeRegions --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun openapiexplorer GET /api/definition --region cn-hangzhou --product Ecs --apiVersion '2014-05-26' --api DescribeRegions --header "Content-Type=application/json"
